SELECT e.employee_name,
       AVG(CASE WHEN ao.order_status_code = 'Success' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_satisfaction_score,
       SUM(CASE WHEN od.delivery_status_code = 'Delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_successful_deliveries
FROM Order_Deliveries od
JOIN Employees e ON od.driver_employee_id = e.employee_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON od.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
WHERE od.delivery_date >= '2023-01-01' AND od.delivery_date < '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name
ORDER BY avg_satisfaction_score DESC, total_successful_deliveries DESC;

SELECT e.employee_id, COUNT(od.actual_order_id) AS total_successful_deliveries FROM Employees e JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON e.employee_id = od.driver_employee_id WHERE od.delivery_status_code = 'Delivered' AND od.delivery_date >= '2023-01-01' AND od.delivery_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY total_successful_deliveries DESC

SELECT 
    dr.route_name,
    AVG(p.product_price) AS avg_satisfaction_score
FROM 
    Delivery_Routes dr

    JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON drl.location_code = od.location_code
    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON od.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Employees e ON od.driver_employee_id = e.employee_id

    AND p.product_price > 5000
    AND julianday('now') - julianday(e.date_hired) > 1095

votes.sql:
SELECT strftime('%W', od.delivery_date) AS week_number,
       e.employee_name AS driver_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_hours
FROM Order_Deliveries od
JOIN Employees e ON od.driver_employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE od.delivery_date >= datetime('now', '-30 days')
GROUP BY week_number, driver_name
ORDER BY total_hours DESC;

SELECT strftime('%W', o.delivery_date) AS week_number, e.employee_name, CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) || ' deliveries' AS total_hours FROM Order_Deliveries o JOIN Employees e ON o.driver_employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE o.delivery_date >= datetime('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY strftime('%W', o.delivery_date), e.employee_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, week_number ASC

WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(delivery_date) AS max_delivery_date FROM "Order_Deliveries"),
filtered AS (
    SELECT od."driver_employee_id",
           strftime('%Y-%W', od."delivery_date") AS year_week,
           COUNT(*) AS total_hours
    FROM "Order_Deliveries" od
    JOIN max_date md ON 1=1
    WHERE od."delivery_date" >= date(md.max_delivery_date, '-1 month')
    GROUP BY od."driver_employee_id", year_week
)
SELECT f.year_week AS week_number,
       e."employee_name" AS driver_name,
       f.total_hours
FROM filtered f
JOIN "Employees" e ON f."driver_employee_id" = e."employee_id"
ORDER BY f.total_hours DESC;

WITH monthly_stats AS (

        strftime('%Y-%m', a.actual_order_date) AS month,
        p.product_name AS category,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS total_revenue,
        AVG(julianday(d.delivery_date) - julianday(a.actual_order_date)) AS avg_delay_days
    FROM Actual_Orders a
    JOIN Actual_Order_Products ap ON a.actual_order_id = ap.actual_order_id
    JOIN Products p ON ap.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Order_Deliveries d ON a.actual_order_id = d.actual_order_id
    WHERE a.actual_order_date >= '2020-01-01' AND a.actual_order_date < '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY month, category
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        category,
        total_revenue,
        avg_delay_days,
        LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
    FROM monthly_stats
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        category,
        total_revenue,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_revenue IS NULL OR prev_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (total_revenue - prev_revenue) * 100.0 / prev_revenue
        END AS growth_pct,
        avg_delay_days,
        NULL AS discount_rate,  -- no discount information in schema
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM with_growth
)
SELECT
    month,
    category,
    total_revenue,
    growth_pct,
    avg_delay_days,
    discount_rate
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY month, rn;

    total_deliveries AS commission_proxy_total,
    ROUND(rolling_avg_3_months, 2) AS rolling_average_comparison

ranked AS (
    SELECT
        dc.*,

        AVG(quarter_commission) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_id, route_id ORDER BY year, quarter

    FROM driver_comm dc
)
SELECT
    r.employee_name AS driver_name,
    r.year || '-Q' || r.quarter AS quarter,
    r.quarter_commission AS quarterly_commission,
    r.route_rank,
    r.rolling_3q_avg AS three_month_rolling_avg_commission,
    l.lifetime_commission AS total_career_commission
FROM ranked r
JOIN lifetime l ON r.employee_id = l.employee_id
ORDER BY l.lifetime_commission DESC, r.year, r.quarter;

votes.sql:
SELECT p.product_name,
       COUNT(*) AS stock_quantity
FROM Actual_Orders AS ao
JOIN Regular_Orders AS ro ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
JOIN Customers AS c ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Customer_Addresses AS ca ON c.customer_id = ca.customer_id
JOIN Addresses AS a ON ca.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN Order_Deliveries AS od ON ao.actual_order_id = od.actual_order_id
JOIN Actual_Order_Products AS aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
JOIN Products AS p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE a.state_province_county = 'Washington'
  AND od.delivery_status_code = 'Delivered'
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY p.product_name;

    p.product_name,

GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name

    p.product_name AS category,
    strftime('%Y-%m', ao.actual_order_date) AS month,
    od.driver_employee_id AS driver_id,
    SUM(p.product_price) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ao.order_status_code = 'Success' THEN 
        (strftime('%s', od.delivery_date) - strftime('%s', ao.actual_order_date)) / 86400.0
    END) AS avg_delivery_duration_days
FROM Actual_Orders ao
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON ao.actual_order_id = od.actual_order_id
WHERE ao.actual_order_date >= '2018-01-01' AND ao.actual_order_date < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY p.product_name, month, od.driver_employee_id
ORDER BY p.product_name, month, od.driver_employee_id;
